description: Defines the ue_fallback_scheduler class responsible for scheduling grants for DL and UL SRB0/SRB1 messages in fallback state within a 5G NR scheduler implementation.

classes.name: ue_fallback_scheduler
classes.description: Scheduler class for managing fallback state grant allocations for UEs, including handling buffer states, contention resolution, and retransmissions.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Handles DL buffer state reports for a UE.

methods.name: handle_ul_bsr_indication
methods.description: Handles UL buffer status report indications.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SRB0 DL grants for a given slot and cells.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, e.g., on cell deactivation.
